note: Land managers' own pages, with what those pages say. Linking needs no data license. Only tag an activity if the cited page says something specific about it, and keep 'about' to what the page states.

official.name: Wolf Den Run State Park
official.about: Maryland DNR's designated ORV riding system, with 12.5 miles of motorized trail, 6.5 of them open to full-size vehicles. Motorized use needs a reservation before you arrive, and every vehicle needs a DNR ORV sticker or MVA registration. Helmets are required. Riding areas aren't connected, and the county roads between them need a Garrett County ATV/OHV permit. Snowmobiles are allowed only on the Huckleberry Rocks loop, when there's snow. It closes to motorized use around Thanksgiving for firearms season. Check fees and days with the park.
official.label: ORV rules and reservations

official.name: Deep Creek Lake State Park
